name: ROCK-SMEAR-inside-out
why: the report: each face takes the normal its corners' order gives - 40 of 48 looking into the rock, culled from outside

name: ROCK-SMEAR-one-plan
old: m.tri(ROCK, a, b, c, nn, boulderUv(a, nn), boulderUv(b, nn), boulderUv(c, nn));
why: the report: the side view (x, -y) laid on every face - the underside one smeared row, the x sides a sliver

name: ROCK-SMEAR-underside-side-view
why: the crown and the underside back on the side view: one row of the picture across them

name: ROCK-SMEAR-x-side-front-view
why: a side that faces x laid by the plan along z: squeezed to a sliver

name: ROCK-SMEAR-signed-lean
old: const ax = Math.abs(n[0]), ay = Math.abs(n[1]), az = Math.abs(n[2]);
new: const ax = n[0], ay = Math.abs(n[1]), az = Math.abs(n[2]);
why: the side facing -x read as leaning on z: smeared

name: ROCK-SMEAR-rows-upside-down
why: a side's picture stood on its head - the rows level, but running up where every other face's run down

name: ROCK-SMEAR-prism-on-trust
why: found beside it: the ramp's deck and the steps' stringers look into their prisms again

name: ROCK-SMEAR-prism-backwards
why: every prism wound against its corners' order

name: ROCK-SMEAR-centroid-off-the-axis
why: AUDIT FB1018f L4-6: a face read against the origin, not the boulder's own axis - a rock stood off its origin faces into itself

name: ROCK-SMEAR-prism-area-half-shoelace
why: AUDIT FB1018f L4-6: half the shoelace - the winding right for the docks' corners, wrong for a prism in another quadrant

name: ROCK-SMEAR-tie-flips
why: AUDIT FB1018f L4-7: a boulder face's centre never lies in its own plane through the axis (the rings are pushed round it), so no face meets the tie

name: ROCK-SMEAR-uv-of-raw-normal
old: boulderUv(a, nn), boulderUv(b, nn), boulderUv(c, nn)
new: boulderUv(a, n), boulderUv(b, n), boulderUv(c, n)
why: AUDIT FB1018f L4-7: boulderUv reads only which of the normal's absolute components is largest, which scaling and the sign leave as they are

name: ROCK-SMEAR-prism-reverse-in-place
why: AUDIT FB1018f L4-7: both callers hand prismZ a list made for the call and never read it after; the copy keeps a caller's list its own
